title: Data-Quality Gap Contract (DC-DQ-GAP-v1)
description: Sprint 31 Data Quality Agent (DQA) contract for a single data-quality gap finding on the gold/serving layer, and the FROZEN seam between Sprint 31 (DQA) and Sprint 32 (Signal Agent, SGA). One record is one below-threshold dimension for one domain: the impacted KPIs/agents, a deterministic impact score in [0,1], a recommended fill source, the accountable owner (advisory / HITL — the owner remediates, DQA never edits source data), the remediation status, and the newSourceNeeded flag. SGA's channel-intake lifecycle is triggered ONLY by a DC-DQ-GAP-v1 record with newSourceNeeded=true; it never onboards a channel no gap demanded (design spec Sec 8, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-27-sprint-31-32-signal-and-data-quality-agents-design.md). Emitted by data-platform/quality/gap_assessment.py; deterministic, no PHI. See docs/adr/0053-dqa-trust-score-model.md.

gapId.description: Stable, deterministic gap identifier derived from domain + dimension.

domain.description: The gold/serving domain the gap was found in, e.g. staffing.skills.

dimension.description: The trust dimension that fell below threshold, e.g. completeness.

impactedKpi.description: KPIs degraded by this gap, e.g. skills-based-assignment, forecast-accuracy.

impactedAgents.description: Platform agents whose decisions this gap degrades, e.g. sba-agent.

impactScore.description: Deterministic impact magnitude in [0,1] — the normalised shortfall vs the threshold.

recommendedSource.description: Recommended fill source for the gap, e.g. { kind: certification-register, example: NAREG / FMH }.

newSourceNeeded.description: The frozen SGA seam flag: true means a new signal channel must be onboarded (Sprint 32 SGA intake trigger).

owner.description: The accountable data owner the gap is routed to (advisory / HITL), e.g. data-owner:staffing.
